single_connection_optimization.comparison_base: Previous optimization's uncommitted release binary (same baseline Git revision as the first receipt)
single_connection_optimization.build: Both binaries built with cargo build --release; release profile unchanged.
single_connection_optimization.method: Native fixture runs are sequential, five samples per target type and build, without concurrent acceptance suites. switch_ms timestamps the fixture receiving a validated target after modeled connection startup; selection_ms runs through process exit and recording. Live tests repeatedly transition from a temporary test-owned tab to the same existing agent pane, asserting full tab and pane IDs. The isolated-config live run disables preview and runs true for directory recording; the user-config live run uses the user's configuration and all default sources. Native reference is one CLI connection for attach, focus_block and client.perform(session.select), without target metadata validation. All live state is isolated and temporary tabs are cleaned.
single_connection_optimization.protocol: One bounded stdin/stdout JSON handshake on a single rex do process. Rust validates the fresh snapshot and client capabilities under the state lock, then replies with full target IDs. Lua focuses and performs session.select using the same connection. Success is acknowledged before Rust updates history. No metadata cache or idle process is added.

default_path_optimization.comparison_base: Release binary captured at the start of this task, before the default-path edits
default_path_optimization.build: Both candidates built with cargo build --release; release profile unchanged.
changes: Reuse the current rendered rows for the same query and catalog revision; invalidate on replacement/removal and reject late results.
Connection snapshots omit presentation titles. Agent connection snapshots read only the selected block's process and program status and take its current window from the fresh view.
Preserve synchronous directory recording and its existing errors.
default_path_optimization.method: Final default measurement uses 11 quiet, alternating before/after pairs, full user configuration and default sources, with no CLI counting wrappers or diagnostic markers. Preview resolves to its unchanged default false; directory recording uses real zoxide. Each run switches from a test-owned tab to the same real agent pane and verifies full window/block IDs. Each binary has isolated state. Native reference uses one CLI connection for attach, focus_block and client.perform(session.select). Enter-to-process-exit includes history and directory recording; native UI input-to-frame latency is not measured. Acceptance suites were not running during timing.
measurement_corrections: The first unwrapped run printed each sample to the agent terminal and measured all old samples before all new samples. It showed no stable improvement (82.011ms vs 87.743ms). These raw results are retained; final inference uses quiet paired sampling to reduce terminal-output and ordering effects. This does not isolate which measurement factor caused the variation.
Stage diagnosis uses temporary trace markers and transparent process wrappers; those add overhead and are not the final absolute timing measurements. All temporary source instrumentation was removed.
